# Security

Use Security → Advisories → Report a vulnerability privately if enabled on this repository.
Otherwise request a private reporting route without posting exploit details or credentials in a public issue.
No dedicated security email address has been assigned.

Include package/version, Android version and reproduction steps without personal data.
Do not send API keys, ADB/signing keys, local addresses, viewing content or raw device output.
`config.properties`, keys and generated packages stay outside Git. API keys embedded in an app are extractable.
The optional separate receiver uses same-certificate checks and a signature-level control permission.
Recovery and protected system components must not be disabled for performance.
